title: Matamshi Bora (Theme 6: Usawa wa kijinsia)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 6 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child recites with the beat and the target sounds clear, and finds every meaning and answer in the lines of the poem.
representations: a two-meaning card for one phrase

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child recites the ubeti and explains the phrase.

misconceptions.ask: Unasikia sauti ya n mwanzoni mwa neno hili?
misconceptions.repair: Tamka sauti ya pua wazi: njia, si jia.

misconceptions.ask: Mshairi anataka nani afanye kazi ya nyumba?
misconceptions.repair: Shairi linafunza kwamba kazi ni ya wote.
Bega kwa bega hapa ni kushirikiana pamoja kwa usawa.

misconceptions.ask: Ni mshororo upi unaotoa jibu hilo?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu kutokana na maneno ya shairi.

checks.question: "Bega kwa bega" katika shairi ni nini?
Ujumbe wa shairi ni?
checks.answer: wavulana na wasichana wana haki sawa
